title: Chronological trip decay and weighted fallback orchestrator
creator: Maya Gonzalez
description: Deliver a new orchestrator that implements chronological trip decay (time-decayed penalties) and weighted fallback decisioning to replace coarse tenant-level hard trips. The goal is to reduce unnecessary model fallbacks during brief anomalies while enforcing SLO-aligned trip behavior across dependency, model, and tenant dimensions. This ticket covers design, simulation, and a pilot rollout behind a feature flag in us-west and eu-central before cross-region expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Reliability and Runtime leads
Simulation shows >= 25% reduction in unnecessary fallbacks on bursty traffic profiles compared to baseline
Feature flag gated rollout exists and can be toggled per-region and per-tenant
Fallback decision logs emitted with reason codes and penalty decay half-life metadata
No customer-facing SLO regressions during pilot (latency P95 and error-rate within existing thresholds)
steps: Draft design with decision lattice for calculating combined trip score (dependency/model/tenant weights + time-decayed penalty)
Implement scoring library and expose RPC for runtime to query decision output
Hook scoring into the request router with feature-flag gating and telemetry hooks
Build simulation harness using historical traces to tune weights and decay half-life
Run canary in us-west for non-critical tenants, monitor metrics and cost impact
Iterate on thresholds, then expand to eu-central for multi-region validation
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Gonzalez: Created ticket after postmortem for spike on 2025-02-09. Main pain: short-lived model latency spikes causing full tenant fallbacks.

2025-02-18 Liam O'Connor: Initial design sketched. Proposal: compute trip_score = sum(weight_i * signal_i) + penalty(timestamp) where penalty decays exponentially. Weights per-dimension (dependency, model, tenant) are tunable via config.

2025-02-21 Priya Menon (Runtime): Concern: extra RPC for scoring could add latency on the critical path. Proposal: cache last decision for short TTL and evaluate score asynchronously for non-blocking thresholds.
2025-02-25 SRE review: Suggested adding a fastpath numeric histogram for per-tenant spikes to avoid locking on heavy requests. Also recommend circuit hysteresis window to avoid flapping.
2025-03-01 Simulation results uploaded. Summary: with decay half-life 90s and tenant weight 0.6, fallback volume reduced by 32% with negligible P95 increase. Linked dashboard above.
2025-03-03 Product feedback (Amir K.): Add explicit reason codes to decision logs so Console can show why a particular request followed fallback path (quality vs cost vs safety).
2025-03-04 Liam O'Connor: Implemented prototype scoring library and unit tests. Preparing PR for runtime integration; will enable behind feature flag 'chrono-trip-v1' for canary tenants.
